consent.words: 开源之前做一次核对，防止开门暴死。先做私有仓库，等检查合格后再开放。
consent.scope: kirkchinese/harness-forge-adapters, private until the pre-publication checks passed, then public; npm @kirkchinese/dsh-adapter-claude-hud-statusline
consent.note: Recorded afterwards from the conversation in which it was given (no later than the time above, before the private repository was created). Publication followed the condition: two independent reviews and a release check (READY TO MAKE PUBLIC) before the repository was made public and the package published.

releases.change: The dock reads the line through Harness Forge 0.2.0's harnessCompat Remote namespace (adapterRead / registerAdapterSurface) instead of its own HTTP route; an older or missing Harness Forge is named in the log and in the dock; Harness Forge >= 0.2.0 is a peer dependency.
releases.checks: node --test: 45 tests, 44 pass, 1 skipped on Windows; a DSH Web check of the status line drawn through adapterRead with Harness Forge 0.2.0 (13 adapterRead calls, no request to the old route).

review.note: First pass found ctx.logger called as a function in the older-Harness-Forge branch; fixed and tested before the verdict.
